title: Connectivity issues and top banner not rendering in xdrip
symptom: The top banner where bg values are displayed is not being rendered. The user is having connectivity issues: 'couldn't pair with miaomiao' despite resetting mm several times. Reinstalling the app did not help and the app display is broken.
fix: The user resolved the issue by going back a few versions of xdrip to install on their device and maintaining connectivity by not upgrading to latest versions.
evidence_quote: managed to resolve it by going back a few versions of xdrip to install on my device
